title: [PreToMe] Not returning results for some shows.
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior I am not getting results for some shows when doing an interactive episode search from Sonarr. If i do a search from Prowlarr directly i get the expected results from PreToMe. Looking at the logs: When the issue is present and Sonarr returns no results, it seems that Prowlarr only queries with the IMDB ID. When the issue is not present and Sonarr returns the correct results, Prowlarr has searched a few times using the IMDB ID, the english title, and the title in other languages it seems. I have pasted a few examples with log snippets. ### Expected Behavior Sonarr returns the same results as Prowlarr for PreToMe when doing an interactive search. ### Steps To Reproduce Search for `The Simpsons : S38E02` or `Slow Horses : S06E03` via an interactive episode search in Sonarr. No results are returned for PreToMe for that episode. ### Environment ```markdown - OS: debian 13 - Sonarr: 4.0.20.3014 (2026-09-16) - Docker Install: yes - Using Reverse Proxy: no - Browser: chrome - Database: Sqlite 3.53.4 ``` ### What branch are you running? Main ### Trace Logs === EXAMPLE 1 - NOT WORKING === = Search from Sonarr for "The Simpsons : S38E02" = Results: No results found in Sonarr for PreToMe for that episode Sonarr log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexers for [The Simpsons : S38E02]. 10 active indexers > [Info] DownloadDecisionMaker: Processing 116 releases Prowler log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [] | ID(s): IMDbId:[0096697] for Season / Episode:[S38E02], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] = Search from Prowlarr directly for "The Simpsons : S38E02" = Results: 1 results found as expected in "TV" category 5000 for PreToMe for that episode Prowler log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [The Simpsons : S38E02], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [5000]

=============================================================== === EXAMPLE 2 - NOT WORKING === = Search from Sonarr for "Slow Horses : S06E03" = Results: No results found for that episode in Sonarr for PreToMe for that episode Sonarr log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexers for [Slow Horses : S06E03]. 10 active indexers > [Info] DownloadDecisionMaker: Processing 160 releases Prowler log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [] | ID(s): IMDbId:[5875444] for Season / Episode:[S06E03], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] = Search from Prowlarr directly for "Slow Horses : S06E03" = Results: 1 results found as expected in "TV" category 5000 for PreToMe for that episode Prowler log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [Slow Horses : S06E03], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [5000]

=============================================================== === EXAMPLE 3 - WORKING === = Interactive search from Sonarr for Below Deck Mediterranean S11 E18 = Results: 1 result found for that episode from PreToMe as expected. Sonarr log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexers for [Below Deck Mediterranean : S11E18]. 10 active indexers > [Info] DownloadDecisionMaker: Processing 49 releases Prowler log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [Below Deck Mediterranean] for Season / Episode:[S11E18], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [Die Yacht Drama unter Deck] for Season / Episode:[S11E18], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [] | ID(s): IMDbId:[5665418] for Season / Episode:[S11E18], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045]

=============================================================== === EXAMPLE 4 - WORKING === = Interactive search from Sonarr for Lanterns S01 E08 = Results: 1 result found for that episode from PreToMe as expected. Sonarr log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexers for [Lanterns : S01E08]. 10 active indexers > [Info] DownloadDecisionMaker: Processing 215 releases Prowler log: > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [Lanterns] for Season / Episode:[S01E08], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [Linternas] for Season / Episode:[S01E08], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] > [Info] ReleaseSearchService: Searching indexer(s): [PreToMe - 750] for Term: [] | ID(s): IMDbId:[26545992] for Season / Episode:[S01E08], Offset: 0, Limit: 100, Categories: [8000, 2000, 5000, 2040, 2030, 2045, 5060, 5040, 5030, 5080, 5045] ### Anything else Do i have something configured incorrectly? I originally thought it may have been a category/sync issue, but its only doing it for some shows. I have noticed it a while ago with a few other shows as well but i don't know what they are at the moment.
